parts.name: Body
parts.Basic_description: The body of the stapler is made of steel and forms the main upper structure that applies pressure to drive staples through paper.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the staple magazine and transfers the pressing force to the staple when the user pushes down.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a hinge at the rear to press down and return to its original position after use.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the stapler is a plastic cover that encloses the staple magazine and provides a surface for the user to press.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the internal mechanism and provides a comfortable surface for the user to apply pressure.
parts.Movement_description: It moves together with the body when pressed down and opens upward for staple refilling.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the stapler is made of steel and serves as the foundation that supports the stapling mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability, holds the anvil plate where staples are bent, and ensures proper alignment during stapling.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, providing a firm base for the moving parts above.
